options.blogdescription: A sample site showing what BimBeau Privacy Analytics reports

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; if ( function_exists( 'bbpa_fs' ) ) { bbpa_fs()->skip_connection(); } $accounts = get_option( 'fs_accounts', array() ); if ( ! is_array( $accounts ) ) { $accounts = array(); } if ( ! isset( $accounts['plugin_data'] ) || ! is_array( $accounts['plugin_data'] ) ) { $accounts['plugin_data'] = array(); } if ( ! isset( $accounts['plugin_data']['bimbeau-privacy-analytics'] ) || ! is_array( $accounts['plugin_data']['bimbeau-privacy-analytics'] ) ) { $accounts['plugin_data']['bimbeau-privacy-analytics'] = array(); } $accounts['plugin_data']['bimbeau-privacy-analytics']['is_anonymous'] = array( 'is' => true, 'timestamp' => time(), 'version' => '1.0.0' ); update_option( 'fs_accounts', $accounts ); delete_transient( 'bbpa_redirect_after_activation' ); require_once '/wordpress/bbpa-demo-data.php'; flush_rewrite_rules( false );
